name: centrifugal_air_compressor_ke
title: Centrifugal air compressor of a gas turbine, power including kinetic energy (exercise 5.14)
summary: Teaching exercise for the power of a gas-turbine centrifugal air compressor, from the steady-flow energy balance with outlet kinetic energy, and for the share of that power that goes into the enthalpy rise. Inlet kinetic energy and potential energy are neglected.

origin.course: ULiège, thermodynamique appliquée, MECA0002, repetition 3, 2022-2023, exercise 5.14

verification.summary: Against the stored solution of R3_E5_2022.EES, compare_solution.py --ees-units reports: 10 common variables, 4 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 0. The maximum it prints is 9.10e-01 on T_in (kelvin kept; the tool rewrites K to °C). h_in and h_out differ by the Air enthalpy offset (+125853 and +126021 J/kg). Power is inside the tolerance (rel 8.95e-04).
verification.reference: EES stored solution in R3_E5_2022.EES (10 variables, EES X10.836), compared with compare_solution.py --ees-units
verification.notes: Largest relative difference printed by compare_solution.py --ees-units is 9.10e-01 on T_in (unrounded 0.9105); T_out is 5.69e-01 (unrounded 0.5690625). The equation window stores 300 K and 480 K and the model keeps those values. The tool subtracts 273.15 before comparing. h_in prints 2.95e-01 (unrounded 0.295223) and h_out 2.07e-01 (unrounded 0.206987). CoolSolve - EES is +125852.9 J/kg at 300 K and +126020.8 J/kg at 480 K. The offset changes by 167.8 J/kg; that cp residual raises the power by 2517.3 W (rel 8.95e-04), inside rtol 0.001. rapW rel 2.45e-05. Pressures, c_out and q_m match. 0 iterations with .initials and 0 without; every block is explicit. Enthalpy guesses are the EES values in J and are not the CoolSolve enthalpies. The AirH2O hint was not followed. The warning that 206.85 is read as °C is the intended property-call argument (480 K - 273.15).
